artifacts.summary: Implementation summary for BL soundness by composition: three new modules, docstring and markdown sync, and the verbatim Phase 6 gate output.
Six-phase plan, all phases now marked [COMPLETED] with measured scope-hypothesis notes and inline deviation annotations.

completion_data.completion_summary: The base language BL now has a native semantics and a soundness theorem. BLTruthAt is defined by six-clause recursion on BLFormula (never as TruthAt (tr phi)), the truth-transfer bridge truthAt_tr is proved by induction, and bl_soundness plus its dense, discrete and Dedekind siblings follow by composing Conservativity.translate with the four BL+ soundness theorems; the Dedekind statement targets BLValidDedekindDense. All seven headline results are sorry-free at exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound], lake build is green, and scripts/check-module-invariants.sh reports ALL CHECKS PASSED on the tree merged with three concurrent sibling tasks.
